QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] A Leafre-y Problem
QuestInfo.1: Bastille says that Leafre has seen an increase in monster activity recently. Odds are that Mystic Gates have opened in the area. \r\nGo to #rLeafre#k and meet up with #bStarling#k. She will know how to proceed.
QuestInfo.2: You met with Starling, who was on mission in Leafre.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:

Can proceed to [Silent Crusade] The New Servant

0.0: Long time no see. I've heard much of your accomplishments and I make it a point to commend the Crusaders under my watch directly. I also have an urgent matter that needs your attention. Will you accept?

yes.0: Mystic Gates are appearing with startling frequency. Leafre in particular has seen a large influx of monster activity. I've sent Starling ahead to scout the area, but I would like you to join her.

no.0: Are you busy right now? I'll contact you again when you are ready to take on your next mission.

1.0: Did Bastille contact you yet? What did he say?

yes.0: I see. We must round up as much support as we can to cover Leafre. There's another matter I'd like you to handle, as well.

npc.0: Speak with #p9073000#, she will be in #r#m240000000##k.
